summary: This manuscript establishes definitive structural, quantitative, and universal advances over Faisal's recent resolution of the 28-year-old Horodecki NPT bound entanglement problem. First, the author proves that under U(d) phase symmetry, Sd-1/Sd-2 permutation symmetry, and Z2 index swap, every d^4 x d^4 operator in B_3,1(d) collapses via an unnormalized integer orthogonal congruence into 9 fixed-size blocks of dimension at most 6x6 with entries quadratic in Z[d]. Using this reduction, the author independently certifies Faisal's d=8 witness and constructs sharper exact rational d=8 witnesses lowering A/B from 23/3 to 4717/625 = 7.5472 (a 35.84% NPT margin increase). Second, via U(d) Haar twirling and 19 exact zero-float rational McCormick dual SDP certificates, the author proves unconditionally that d_min = 8 is the exact sharp integer dimension threshold (ruling out d in {3,4,5,6,7}). Third, the author constructs a single explicit universal rational witness family Q(d) certifying NPT bound entanglement simultaneously for every integer d >= 8 (certified by 102/102 positive Bareiss Sylvester minors) and demonstrates sublinear O(sqrt(d)) NPT depth scaling up to d=100 (A/B = 24.65, 4.057x relative NPT depth). All algebraic and combinatorial cores are formally verified in Lean 4.35.0 (0 sorry) and an AST-audited zero-float Python verifier with 16 SHA-256 certificates.
